description: Type the 403 `host-not-yours` that a write adding routes gets for a hostname the team may not use. The spec documents it on PUT /v1/apps/{project} (putApp: "another route is 403 `host-not-yours`") and PATCH /v1/apps/{project}/routes (patchRoutes: "other names are 403 `host-not-yours`"); createBuild takes the same `spec` and checks route ownership up front. The provider guide lists it under 403 ("`host-not-yours` means a route outside the team's names and verified domains", https://sproutboat.com/docs/api/build-a-provider#errors-and-retries). It generated as the generic Forbidden.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: A route is neither under the team's own `<name>.<team slug>.sproutboat.app` nor on a custom domain the team has verified.
